method.hostRss: macOS ps RSS at100ms; phase final median of final10samples after1.2sec settle; sampled peaks can miss shorter spikes
method.browserRss: isolated Chrome SystemInfo process IDs, ps RSS seven samples at80ms; browser, renderer and other categories separate; RSS includes shared pages, does not establish exact physical RAM
method.heap: Runtime.getHeapUsage before GC (natural point sample) and after explicit HeapProfiler.collectGarbage (retained JS heap); excludes native browser/GPU/process costs; prior phase GC affects following phase
method.instrumentation: scalar counters only; no full source or protocol messages retained; source split/encoder/storage/DOM wrappers are equal overhead in A/B
method.timing: native Playwright key input, capture-to-document-bubble app handler duration; double animation frame observation for scroll; Chrome Performance.getMetrics workload deltas; single-machine timings noisy
method.providers: both CLIs shadowed with disposable fixtures; no real credentials or inference
